# Super Taco flagship menu and Toast setup

The system presets `preset-sig-qsr-24-super-taco` and `preset-sig-qsr-24-super-taco-portrait` use one editable 4K board at `apps/web/public/templates/signage/qsr/24-super-taco-flagship.html`. Its six starter products and displayed prices are preview content based on the public Super Taco Calvine Toast ordering menu; verify them before publishing an unconnected board. Brand logo and food photo were obtained from [Super Taco's official site](https://www.supertacomex.com/). The logo and hero photo are local assets so a screen does not depend on Wix availability.

To connect Toast, open **Settings → POS → Toast** and enter the Toast API endpoint, machine-client ID and secret, and each store's name and restaurant GUID. Toast provides the endpoint and credentials through its API access process. The connector authenticates server-side and requests `/menus/v2/menus` for each restaurant GUID using a bearer token and `Toast-Restaurant-External-ID`. Credentials are envelope-encrypted in the existing POS connection store. The first sync runs when the connection is created; a manual **Sync now** button and the five-minute metadata check keep it current. No credentials are embedded in the template or repository.

After sync, use the connection's **Stores** mapping to pair each Toast restaurant with its VenueOS location tenant, then place the template on those screens. The connector checks Toast Menus V2 metadata every five minutes and downloads a new catalog only after Toast reports a newer publication. The existing device menu endpoint resolves the mapped location's price and the screen sends menu changes to the board every 30 seconds. Names, base prices, descriptions, categories, and Toast item photos update in the board's six slots. Items no longer in Toast's published menu become unavailable in both POS and menu catalogs. A configured but empty catalog clears the sample products; an unconfigured screen retains the starter preview.

The connector deliberately omits Toast open, size-based, and time-specific prices because a single menu-board price would be misleading without evaluating those rules. Toast Menus V2 does not provide stock/86 status here, and this connector currently polls rather than consuming Toast's menus webhook. Those capabilities must be added before claiming immediate or stock-level updates.

Sources: [Toast authentication](https://doc.toasttab.com/doc/devguide/authentication.html), [Menus V2](https://doc.toasttab.com/openapi/menus/operation/menusGet/), [Menu metadata](https://doc.toasttab.com/openapi/menus/operation/metadataGet/), [MenuItem pricing](https://doc.toasttab.com/openapi/menus/tag/Data-definitions/schema/MenuItem/), [Super Taco Calvine ordering](https://order.toasttab.com/online/supertaco-calvine).
